hero.title: A guided tour of Heuresys
hero.subtitle: Ten stops on the RTL Bank reference tenant: from the org structure to capability maturity, all the way to the executive dashboard. Real data, no slides.

s01.narration: What a buyer sees — and how a contact becomes a record.

s02.shows: RTL Bank's real org chart (158 positions, 26 units)
s02.narration: Position-centric: the chair, not the person — the bank's real structure.

s03.shows: The bank's positions with their requirements
s03.narration: Each position carries its own skill and KPI requirements, independent of who sits in it.

s04.narration: Where the bank is strong and where it's thin — computed live, not a slide.

s05.narration: Predictive people analytics — and the why: every score breaks down into weighted features.

s06.shows: L0-L5 organizational capability maturity by unit
s06.narration: The differentiator: organizational maturity rolled up bottom-up from real evidence.

s07.narration: Processes are owned, with live RACI accountability per org unit.

s08.shows: AI matching to ESCO occupations and positions, with affinity
s08.narration: Through the employee's eyes: the engine matches me to occupations and roles, with an affinity score.

s09.narration: Scope is enforced, not cosmetic — a manager sees his team, no further.

s10.narration: A live overview: users, positions, critical gaps and recent activity at a glance.
